data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104's gross claims outstanding decreased from GBP 45.216m at 31 December 2013 to GBP 27.796m at 31 December 2014, implying a gross release of approximately GBP 17.42m (net release of GBP 22.6m reported). The improvement primarily reflects favourable development on prior natural catastrophe losses (notably reductions in loss estimates related to Hurricane Ike, the Japanese earthquake, Thai floods and a reduction on Hurricane Sandy) and related reinsurance recoveries, and mainly affects the Syndicate's treaty reinsurance/property exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: A release of GBP 22.6m from the net reserve for claims outstanding, set at 31 December 2013, has been made in calendar year 2014.
Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2012 had a release of GBP 9.0m in calendar year 2013.

The old years' release of GBP 2m benefited from reductions in the loss estimates for Hurricane Ike, the Japanese earthquake and Thai floods. The pure year benefited from a reduction in the loss estimate for Hurricane Sandy.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening and closing claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet comparatives. There is no explicit 'movement in prior year's provision (gross)' note; the notes state a net release (GBP 22.6m). Gross prior year movement was derived from the change in the gross claims outstanding balance (45.216 -> 27.796 = -17.42) and so is flagged as calculated (confidence 0.8). No gross claims development triangle provided for Syndicate 6104 in the report.
